shortDescription: Polymarket’s "2H O/U 19.5" submarket in the "Jets vs. Lions" event saw the "Over" option’s implied win probability swing sharply from 50% one hour earlier to 67% at the time of monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the 17-point move may reflect the impact of breaking news.
